style.name: Scrapbook
style.description: Scrapbook design borrows the visual language of collected photographs, paper scraps, handwritten notes, and tape. Overlaps and small irregularities make the composition feel personal while an underlying structure keeps it navigable.

fonts.heading: Caveat
fonts.rationale: Handwritten headings create a personal touch; conventional body text keeps longer notes and navigation accessible.

tips: Repeat a small set of paper and tape treatments.
Keep important controls level and readable.
Use handwriting for short expressive moments.

recipe.composition: Arrange a few layered paper pieces with slight offsets; keep navigation and text baselines dependable.
recipe.motion: Tiny press feedback makes paper feel tangible; keep larger collages still.
recipe.signature: Handwritten accents, paper layering, and collected details rather than random clutter.
